title: Assign Cookies
description: Assume you are an awesome parent and want to give your children some cookies. Each child `i` has a greed factor `g[i]`, and each cookie `j` has a size `s[j]`. If `s[j] >= g[i]`, the child is content. Maximize the number of content children.
input_format: First line contains `n` and `m`. Second line contains `g`. Third line contains `s`.
hints: Sort both greed factors and cookie sizes in ascending order.
Greedily satisfy the least greedy child with the smallest possible sufficient cookie.
Advance both pointers when a match is found.

reference_solution:
import sys
data = sys.stdin.read().split()
if data:
    n, m = int(data[0]), int(data[1])
    g = sorted([int(x) for x in data[2:2+n]])
    s = sorted([int(x) for x in data[2+n:2+n+m]])
    i = j = 0
    while i < n and j < m:
        if s[j] >= g[i]: i += 1
        j += 1
    print(i)
